$description: D6 — the exclusion register and the watchlist, as the records Phase 2 item 2.1 would add to data/. PROPOSED in v2 Session 2; nothing here is in data/. Each entry is an instrument record in the exact shape of data/instruments.json, carrying the new `scope_decision` block and the new `status_basis` field (docs/v2-design/map.schema.json). The register is DERIVED as the records whose decision says `excluded`, the watchlist as those whose decision says `watched`: neither is a list anybody maintains.
$note: ONE HOME. When item 2.1 is implemented, each block below is MOVED into its data file — `instruments` into data/instruments.json `instruments[]`, `relationships` into its `relationships[]`, `sources` into data/sources.json, `events` into data/timeline.json, `source_updates` applied in place — and this file is deleted in the same commit, so the facts never live in two places. EVIDENCE. Every fact below was read on 25 Oct 2026 from a document retrieved that day: the Official Journal text through the Publications Office's Cellar by CELEX number, the Publications Office's metadata through its SPARQL endpoint (in-force flag, entry-into-force dates), the Commission proposals through Cellar, and the European Parliament's Legislative Observatory procedure files. No fact was taken from a search result or from model knowledge; where a fact was not read it is null, and the note says what is missing. EDITORIAL. Every `reason` is a DRAFT for the author's approval, and every `approved_on` is null until the author approves the entry in docs/ROADMAP-v2.md §8 — a record with a null `approved_on` may not enter data/ (rule M-04): the judgement is the author's (docs/AI-SAFE-BOUNDARIES.md §2), and the inclusion criterion it applies (D-7) is itself not yet approved. On 27 Oct 2026 the author decided which list p2b joins (the watchlist, Q-1) and that the finance-chapter condition applies to the dga (Q-6), and chose to review every reason before it is approved: `approved_on` stays null until then.
$assumptions: A-1 (checked against the brief on 27 Oct 2026): the seven regimes are the brief's (ViDA, AVMSD, copyright, GPSR, EAA, P2B, political advertising). The brief puts them in 'the register of exclusions OR the watchlist': six are excluded by the criterion's crit:other-field; P2B is watched (the author's decision of 27 Oct 2026, Q-1).

A-2: 'copyright' is read as Directive (EU) 2019/790 (copyright in the Digital Single Market), the copyright act the DSA's Art. 2(4)(b) reaches most directly. The brief's own word is 'copyright'; if it meant the copyright acquis as a whole, the entry widens and the author says so.

A-3 (confirmed against the brief on 27 Oct 2026): the watchlist holds the brief's 'inclusioni condizionate Fase 3 — MiCA, PSD3/PSR, DGA in transizione — solo se si apre esplicitamente il capitolo finanza'. PSD3 and PSR are two proposals and are two records; all four watch for the finance chapter only.
A-4: 'AVMSD' is read as Directive 2010/13/EU (the codified version) as amended, notably by Directive (EU) 2018/1808.
